entries.title: Genesis 49:1
segments: ¶And Jacob called his sons and said, "Gather together, that I may tell you what shall befall you in the last days:

entries.title: Genesis 49:2
segments: "Gather together and hear, you sons of Jacob, And listen to Israel your father.

entries.title: Genesis 49:3
segments: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, My might and the beginning of my strength, The excellency of dignity and the excellency of power.

entries.title: Genesis 49:4
segments: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, Because you went up to your father's bed; Then you defiled [it] -He went up to my couch.

entries.title: Genesis 49:5
segments: ¶"Simeon and Levi [are] brothers; Instruments of cruelty [are in] their dwelling place.

entries.title: Genesis 49:6
segments: Let not my soul enter their council; Let not my honor be united to their assembly; For in their anger they slew a man, And in their self-will they hamstrung an ox.

entries.title: Genesis 49:7
segments: Cursed [be] their anger, for [it is] fierce; And their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob And scatter them in Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 49:8
segments: ¶"Judah, you [are he] whom your brothers shall praise; Your hand [shall be] on the neck of your enemies; Your father's children shall bow down before you.

entries.title: Genesis 49:9
segments: Judah [is] a lion's whelp; From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He bows down, he lies down as a lion; And as a lion, who shall rouse him?

entries.title: Genesis 49:10
segments: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, Nor a lawgiver from between his feet, Until Shiloh comes; And to Him [shall be] the obedience of the people.

entries.title: Genesis 49:11
segments: Binding his donkey to the vine, And his donkey's colt to the choice vine, He washed his garments in wine, And his clothes in the blood of grapes.

entries.title: Genesis 49:12
segments: His eyes [are] darker than wine, And his teeth whiter than milk.

entries.title: Genesis 49:13
segments: ¶"Zebulun shall dwell by the haven of the sea; He [shall become] a haven for ships, And his border shall adjoin Sidon.

entries.title: Genesis 49:14
segments: "Issachar is a strong donkey, Lying down between two burdens;

entries.title: Genesis 49:15
segments: He saw that rest [was] good, And that the land [was] pleasant; He bowed his shoulder to bear [a burden], And became a band of slaves.

entries.title: Genesis 49:16
segments: "Dan shall judge his people As one of the tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 49:17
segments: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, A viper by the path, That bites the horse's heels So that its rider shall fall backward.

entries.title: Genesis 49:18
segments: I have waited for your salvation, O LORD!

entries.title: Genesis 49:19
segments: "Gad, a troop shall tramp upon him, But he shall triumph at last.

entries.title: Genesis 49:20
segments: "Bread from Asher [shall be] rich, And he shall yield royal dainties.

entries.title: Genesis 49:21
segments: "Naphtali [is] a deer let loose; He uses beautiful words.

entries.title: Genesis 49:22
segments: ¶"Joseph [is] a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a well; His branches run over the wall.

entries.title: Genesis 49:23
segments: The archers have bitterly grieved him, Shot [at him] and hated him.

entries.title: Genesis 49:24
segments: But his bow remained in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong By the hands of the Mighty [God] of Jacob (From there [is] the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel),

entries.title: Genesis 49:25
segments: By the God of your father who will help you, And by the Almighty who will bless you [With] blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that lies beneath, Blessings of the breasts and of the womb.

entries.title: Genesis 49:26
segments: The blessings of your father Have excelled the blessings of my ancestors, Up to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him who was separate from his brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 49:27
segments: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; In the morning he shall devour the prey, And at night he shall divide the spoil."

entries.title: Genesis 49:28
segments: ¶All these [are] the twelve tribes of Israel, and this [is] what their father spoke to them. And he blessed them; he blessed each one according to his own blessing.

entries.title: Genesis 49:29
segments: Then he charged them and said to them: "I am to be gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that [is] in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

entries.title: Genesis 49:30
segments: "in the cave that [is] in the field of Machpelah, which [is] before Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite as a possession for a burial place.

entries.title: Genesis 49:31
segments: "There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife, there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I buried Leah.

entries.title: Genesis 49:32
segments: "The field and the cave that [is] there [were] purchased from the sons of Heth."

entries.title: Genesis 49:33
segments: And when Jacob had finished commanding his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed and breathed his last, and was gathered to his people.
